description:
Clean up your Zotero library by moving specific irrelevant papers to the Trash. You have a library of 18 papers. You must move EXACTLY these 4 papers to the Trash:

1. 'On the Electrodynamics of Moving Bodies' (Einstein, 1905)
2. 'Molecular Structure of Nucleic Acids: A Structure for Deoxyribose Nucleic Acid' (Watson & Crick, 1953)
3. 'The Mathematical Theory of Communication' (Shannon & Weaver, 1949) -> Note: This is the book. Do NOT trash the 1948 paper 'A Mathematical Theory of Communication'.
4. 'An Unsolvable Problem of Elementary Number Theory' (Church, 1936)

All other 14 papers must remain in your library. Do not empty the trash, just move the items there.
